subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling and pre-reads
message_1_subject: Re: Discovery - dedicated capacity next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: Nimbus is planning an LLM-powered assistant for enterprise customers with an initial English rollout. Typical user session is ~350 tokens input + 150 tokens output. Expected steady-state throughput ~20 requests/sec with peak bursts to 150 concurrent sessions during business hours. Latency SLO target is 200–300ms p50 for completion tokens.

- Goal for the next call: a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) to translate your throughput/latency targets into a recommended Dedicated configuration (GPU type, pool size, batching/kv-cache considerations) and a lift-and-shift plan for canary rollout.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule the dedicated capacity sizing call (30–45m) with your engineering lead + our SE.
2) Pre-read: I can send a short sizing workbook to fill in a few metrics (peak RPS, average prompt lengths, percent of streaming responses, expected token retention for cache).
3) Goals for the call: recommended config, estimated tokens-per-second capacity, and an initial monthly cost estimate for Dedicated.

I’m copying Camila (our solutions engineer) to join the call. Do any of these time windows work for you next week?

- Tues 6/23 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 6/24 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 6/25 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those fit I’ll drop a Calendly/Cal link. I’ll also attach the sizing workbook for you to review.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: nimbus_sizing_workbook.xlsx (workbook with throughput/latency fields)
message_2_subject: Re: Discovery - dedicated capacity next steps
message_2_body:
Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. We definitely want the dedicated sizing call and will have our infra lead (Priya) join. A few pieces to help you size ahead of the call: 

- Estimated steady-state: 20 req/s (avg), average 500 tokens total (input+output).
- Peak: concurrent sessions ~150, simultaneous token-generation concurrency ~30 (many are short bursts).
- Streaming: ~70% of responses will be streamed back to the client.
- Caching: we expect about 10–15% cache hit rates initially (prefix reuse is limited).
- Compliance: data residency in US only; SOC2 and audit logs required.

We can do Wed 6/24 14:00 PT — that slot works for Priya and myself. Please send the invite and the sizing workbook; I’ll have Priya fill the workbook before the call.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform, Nimbus AI
alex.chen@nimbusai.com
+1 (212) 555-0124
